3D Reconstruction Model Tests (Grouped by fairness)

Here is a viewer to visualize the ablations of different 3D reconstruction priors for rigid objects. Not all of them are fair comparisons (some take many images as input, some (eg, SAM3D) only take 1) so they are grouped such that within each group, the comparisons are 'apples to apples'. SAM3D and ShapeR produce the objects with the best reconstruction scores, and these reconstructions lead to the best pose estimations. Use the arrow keys to quickly go through the results, this can help you understand which inputs cause failures and why. Additionally, there are tables that show average results for each batch of tests and scores for each object, just note this is duplicate information that is already covered in the quantitative information section
